reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the exact intervention (50 at.% Pt addition, sputtering, RTA), mechanism (L1₀ ordering, spin–orbit coupling), and predicted outcome (three orders of magnitude coercivity increase) from the FeCoNiMnCu system studied in P3–P6 to the simpler FeCoNi system, without providing a new mechanistic justification or addressing why the removal of Mn and Cu would not alter the ordering behavior. This is a minor compositional change that restates the reported result as a prediction.
copied_elements: Introducing ~50 at.% Pt into a FeCoNi-based alloy
Sputtering and rapid thermal annealing (RTA) on Si/SiO2 substrates
Strong spin–orbit coupling from Pt enhances magnetocrystalline anisotropy
Coercivity increase by up to three orders of magnitude
Use of XRD and TEM to confirm L1₀ phase
